note: Lamar County AL parcels are published only through a Flagship GIS hosted web viewer (lamar.alabamagis.com, proprietary Flagship MapServer). No public ArcGIS REST, WFS, OGC or bulk download exists: the NSGIC 2025 portal lists Lamar with digital parcels but blank REST API and download URLs. The Flagship mapserver root returns 500 on rest/services. Lamar is absent from the PowerSouth Alabama_Parcel_Data service, and the county site only links to a tax payment portal. Regrid nationwide parcels is not queryable.
